Barcelona target Man Utd's Martinez - Friday's gossip
- Published
Barcelona interested in Lisandro Martinez, while Manchester United target Fulham defensive pair and Liverpool scout Serie A top scorer, plus more.
Manchester United and Argentina defender Lisandro Martinez, 28, could be a January target for Barcelona, who are looking to shore up their defence. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish), external
Meanwhile, Manchester United are considering a raid on Fulham for United States left-back Antonee Robinson, 29, and Nigeria centre-back Calvin Bassey, 26, in January. (the i - subscription required), external
USA and Monaco striker Folarin Balogun, 25, and Freiburg's 23-year-old Croatia forward Igor Matanovic are also of interest to Manchester United. (the i - subscription required), external
Liverpool have sent scouts to watch Monza striker Gustavo Varela. The 21-year-old Portuguese is the top scorer in Serie A and also has interest from Juventus. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian), external
Bournemouth are now expecting offers close to their £100m valuation for England midfielder Alex Scott, 23, with Chelsea in the driving seat to sign him. (Teamtalk), external
Roma are interested in a January deal for Chelsea's 22-year-old English winger Jamie Bynoe-Gittens. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian), external
AC Milan have identified Napoli and Scotland midfielder Scott McTominay, 29, as a top transfer target, with Real Madrid and Manchester United also interested. (Quotidiano Nazionale - in Italian), external
AC Milan and Roma are hoping that Real Madrid can be persuaded to sell Brazil forward Endrick, 20, in January after setting a valuation of around 70m euros (£58m). (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian), external
Arsenal are continuing to monitor Brentford and Germany attacker Kevin Schade, 24, as they weigh up a January move. (Teamtalk), external
Mauricio Pochettino wants Manchester United to remove director of football Jason Wilcox and replace him with Paul Mitchell, who the Argentine worked with at Southampton and Tottenham. (Football Insider), external
